title: PRD btt services
summary: Ledgerline PRD battery end-of-line test services managing pack test records, queries, electrical measurement validation, and archive searches on screen QA-BTT-03.
body:
The `btt` service group provides backend services in the PRD module for managing battery pack end-of-line test records on screen [[screen-qa-btt-03|QA-BTT-03]] [^r3][^r7]. Introduced in Ledgerline 7.2.0, the group comprises `btt_save`, `btt_get`, and `btt_search` to record, retrieve, and search electrical testing results including pack serial numbers, item codes, open-circuit voltages (OCV), internal resistances, and pass/fail statuses [^r3][^r8][^r11][^r21]. All endpoints require POST requests with session token authentication supplied in the `X-LL-Session` header and an authorised role [^r12][^r17][^r22].

## Services

### btt_get

Retrieves battery end-of-line test data from the battery archive for screen [[screen-qa-btt-03|QA-BTT-03]] [^r4][^r9][^r11].

* **Endpoint**: `POST /ll72/svc/btt_get` [^r12]
* **Operation**: Read [^r11]
* **Required fields**: `serial_no` (string, PACK SERIAL) [^r4][^r9][^r13]
* **Optional fields**: None [^r13]
* **Returns**: Envelope with `rc`, `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` containing `itm_cd`, `ocv`, `ir_mohm`, `result`, and `status` [^r4][^r14]
* **Errors**: `ERR-BTT-0001` (BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST NOT FOUND), `ERR-SEC-0001`, `ERR-SYS-0421`, `ERR-SYS-0422`, `ERR-SYS-0503` [^r1][^r15]
* **Source file**: `04_service_definitions/production/btt_get.yaml` [^r11]

### btt_save

Validates electrical measurements, writes the battery end-of-line test record to the database via stored procedure `sp_btt_save`, and locks the record against modification [^r6][^r8][^r20].

* **Endpoint**: `POST /ll72/svc/btt_save` [^r16]
* **Operation**: Write [^r8][^r16]
* **Required fields**: `serial_no` (string, PACK SERIAL), `itm_cd` (string, ITEM CD), `ocv` (float, OCV (V)), `ir_mohm` (float, IR (MOHM)), and `result` (string, PASS/FAIL) [^r8][^r18]
* **Optional fields**: None [^r18]
* **Returns**: Envelope with `rc`, `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r19]
* **Errors**: `ERR-BTT-0110` (battery serial number already tested), `ERR-BTT-0120` (open-circuit voltage out of range) [^r2]
* **Source file**: `04_service_definitions/production/btt_save.yaml` [^r16]

### btt_search

Queries and returns a list of recent battery end-of-line test records filtered by criteria on screen [[screen-qa-btt-03|QA-BTT-03]] [^r5][^r10][^r21].

* **Endpoint**: `POST /ll72/svc/btt_search` [^r21]
* **Operation**: Read [^r21]
* **Required fields**: None [^r23]
* **Optional fields**: `serial_no` (string, PACK SERIAL), `itm_cd` (string, ITEM CD), `ocv` (float, OCV (V)), and `status` (string, STATUS) [^r10][^r23]
* **Returns**: Envelope with `rc`, `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r24]
* **Errors**: [[err-itm-0011|ERR-ITM-0011]] (ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE), `ERR-SEC-0001`, `ERR-SYS-0421`, `ERR-SYS-0422`, `ERR-SYS-0503` [^r25]
* **Source file**: `04_service_definitions/production/btt_search.yaml` [^r21]

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-BTT-0001 BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST NOT FOUND Cause: no document or record with that key exists. Remedy: check the number with the list service or the F2 lookup. Raised by: btt_get.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: ERR-BTT-0110 SERIAL ALREADY TESTED Cause: the rule 'serial already tested' failed. Remedy: correct the value shown and try again; if the message persists, quote the code to the key user. Raised by: btt_save. ERR-BTT-0120 OCV OUT OF RANGE Cause: the rule 'ocv out of range' failed. Remedy: correct the value shown and try again; if the message persists, quote the code to the key user. Raised by: btt_save.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Screen QA-BTT-03, menu Production > Battery end-of-line. Services: btt_save, btt_get, btt_search.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: enter the serial into PACK SERIAL and press btt_get. This action invokes the BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST GET service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 queries the battery archive and populates ITEM CD, OCV (V), IR (MOHM), PASS/FAIL, and STATUS

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Press btt_search to invoke BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST LIST. This produces a list of recent records filtered by date and production line

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: press btt_save to run the BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST SAVE service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 processes the entry, validates the values against system constraints, commits the test result to the database, and locks the record

r7.loc_text: p. 31, QA-BTT-03 BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST ENTRY
r7.quote: Save F8 btt_save Get F3 btt_get Search F2/Enter btt_search

r8.loc_text: p. 60, btt_save BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST SAVE
r8.quote: btt_save BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST SAVE Kind: write. Screen: QA-BTT-03. Since: 7.2.0. Procedures: sp_btt_save.

r9.loc_text: p. 61, btt_get BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST GET
r9.quote: btt_get BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST GET Kind: read. Screen: QA-BTT-03. Since: 7.2.0. Procedures: none.

r10.loc_text: p. 61, btt_search BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST LIST
r10.quote: btt_search BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST LIST Kind: read. Screen: QA-BTT-03. Since: 7.2.0. Procedures: none.
